title: Skin Care for Mysore Weather: A Routine for Sunny Summers, Dasara Season and Cool Dry Winters
ex: Mild most of the year, hot and dry in summer and cool and dry in winter: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Mysuru.
rt: Skin Care for Mysore Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Mysore weather: sun care for hot dry summers, Dasara makeup tips, light layers in the monsoon and a richer night routine for cool, dry winters.
quick: Mysuru is pleasant for much of the year, hot and dry from March to May, moderately rainy from June to November and cool and dry from December to February. Use a gentle face wash, daily broad-spectrum sunscreen, a light moisturiser and a thin night cream, a little richer in winter.
facts: Mysuru is on the Deccan plateau in southern Karnataka
It is often a little warmer and drier than Bengaluru
Mysuru Dasara usually falls in September or October
Winter mornings are cool and the air is dry
